admission_requirements: Spanish language verified at document or chunk level
underlying text license verified, not merely dataset-script license
attractor denylist applied before deduplication and admission
OCR and encoding quality checks where applicable

sources.notes: Dataset card reports 302640 texts and 13.9 billion words; split into coherent context-sized chunks, inspect OCR and retain title/author/source metadata.
Large newspaper archive; verify underlying publication/date/public-domain basis per source and filter OCR, duplicated syndication and attractor terms.
Filter language=Spanish and include only public-domain or explicitly approved permissive licenses. Never ingest the multilingual aggregate wholesale.
Retain attribution and ShareAlike obligations where applicable; deduplicate against existing corpus.
Retain author/source attribution and license version; do not strip post-level metadata.
Only documents with explicit reuse permissions; do not assume open access means unrestricted training rights.

sources.dataset: Permissively licensed technical manuals and code
sources.notes: Keep repository/file provenance and license; filter generated boilerplate, vendored code and repeated templates.
Target 10–15% final share. Prefer varied dialogue and voice samples; synthetic examples must be labeled and must not encode real personal biographies.
